summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 P2 enhancements to Cyber Crisis Commander (CRISIS-0002) as admin jblan2026@gmail.com. All acceptance criteria pass. (1) Comms Center coverage scorecard renders with all 6 stakeholder rows and flag badges (initial state 'NOT UPDATED' across all groups — intended honest empty state). Refresh button present. (2) One-tap dispatch: audience=Customer + template=Customer holding statement auto-fills the textarea (216 chars). Dispatch produced 'Template applied / Customer notified' toast, the customer coverage row flipped from NOT UPDATED -> CURRENT with 'Last updated 0m ago · 1 update(s)', and Communication Log crisis-comms-event-0 appeared. (3) Template management: Templates toggle opens crisis-comms-manage listing the 4 defaults (reg-holding, cust-holding, emp-advisory, board-update). Added TEST_TPL under customer group -> list grew to 5; deleted it -> 'Template removed' toast and list restored to 4 defaults (cleanup verified). (4) Resilience: crisis-resilience-intelligence + all 4 KPIs (including crisis-resilience-kpi-rto = 0 breaches / 0 items) render. crisis-resilience-rto panel shows 1 row for existing recovery item REC-0017 (TEST_ Order Mgmt). Set RTO=240, RPO=60, saved -> 'Objectives saved' toast, status badge = 'Met'. (5) Regression: AI Incident Intel (crisis-ai-incident-intelligence), Identity Crisis (crisis-identity-intelligence with crisis-risky-users + crisis-entra-containment honest 'Entra not connected' states), and Post-Incident Review (crisis-pir-dashboard) all render. All 18 crisis tabs switch cleanly with no white screen / no runtime crash.
